'Crank / This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it. / Action - 0: Target hero destroys the top card of their deck.' Mechanologist Action - Item (batch set label BrightLights). REWRITES the earlier draft of this same file, which authored the upkeep as MAY{REMOVE_COUNTERS / else DESTROY_SELF}; reason below, verified in source this session.

CRANK NOT AUTHORED: printed keyword (printed_keywords), fires engine-side from the card DB keywords field via ability_keywords.crank (ability_keywords.py:564-579, read this session: an optional removal that gains an action point). Re-authoring it would be a defect. The steam-counter paragraph is NOT part of Crank - it is this card's own text and is authored below.

ENTRY COUNTER: TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY + PUT_COUNTER counter_type steam amount 1. ON_ENTER_PLAY is dispatched from Zone.add on real arena entry (state.py:304-310); PUT_COUNTER reads counter_type/amount and defaults its target to the SOURCE card (effect_types.py:2015-2058), and effect_put_counter writes BOTH tallies - card.counters['steam'] and the player-level dict keyed (slug, zone, kind) (ability_keywords.py:1653-1660).

UPKEEP 'DESTROY UNLESS YOU REMOVE' as PAY_OR_ELSE {counter_type steam, amount 1, on_failure DESTROY_SELF} - the handler docstring names exactly this pattern ('destroy this UNLESS you remove a steam counter from it' ... the recurring Crank/steam pattern, effect_types.py:3213-3215). Why not the earlier draft's MAY:
(1) ZERO-COUNTER CORRECTNESS. crank() decrements ONLY the player-level tally controller.counters[(slug, zone, 'steam')] (ability_keywords.py:568-576) and never touches card.counters, so after a Crank removal the item can be at player-tally 0 with a stale card-level 1. A MAY+REMOVE_COUNTERS shape still offers removal at 0 counters and REMOVE_COUNTERS clamps at max(0, ...) (ability_keywords.py:1663-1670), so declining-or-accepting both let the item survive where the printed text destroys it - the exact defect class recorded in .draft-review/dissipation_shield_yellow.json. PAY_OR_ELSE reads the PLAYER-level tally (effect_types.py:3239), offers the pay/decline prompt only when have >= 1, and runs on_failure without a prompt otherwise - printed-correct in both directions.
(2) THE RELEASE NOTE IS ITS PROMPT VERBATIM: 'Removing a steam counter is optional. If you choose not to remove a steam counter, it is simply destroyed' = PAY_OR_ELSE's pay/decline choice with decline running on_failure (effect_types.py:3230-3257, read this session). The asker is tid = SELF default = the controller; 'your turn' holds because START_OF_TURN dispatches to the ACTIVE player's zones only and _dsl_permanent_zones includes player.items (engine.py:1452-1466, read this session).
(3) TALLIES STAY CONSISTENT: its pay path routes through effect_remove_counter, which decrements BOTH tallies (ability_keywords.py:1663-1670).

ACTIVATED ABILITY: ACTIVATE + card-level activation_cost 0 (DSL-authoritative per DSL_REFERENCE; NOT also modelled as a cost, which would double-charge). No per_turn field - release note 2 rules activations unlimited ('as many times as you want as long as you have the action points'). Item ACTIVATE abilities are offered by play._add_hero_dsl_activations, whose source scan includes player.items.

'TARGET HERO' IS AN APPROXIMATION, disclosed: no generic hero-target declaration flows into these effects (the triage note for this card says the same), so the hero choice is expressed as a resolution-time CHOOSE between milling your own or the opposing hero's deck - the option the triage explicitly blesses over TARGET_HERO_CLASS_IN class-list gymnastics. Each branch is LOOK_AT zone DECK_TOP amount 1 into ref + DESTROY_REF ref: LOOK_AT stores a single card unwrapped (effect_types.py:3356-3415) and DESTROY_REF destroys it through canonical destroy() (effect_types.py:3417-3428); an empty deck stores None and DESTROY_REF no-ops safely. Cost of the approximation: the choice is made at resolution rather than when the ability is put on the stack (CR 1.8.5), which is observable only if something reacts between activation and resolution.

No printed-keyword conditional machinery applies (nothing gates Crank), and no gaps beyond the disclosed targeting approximation.
